meta.name: mcp-developer
meta.description: Use when building, debugging, or extending MCP servers or clients that connect AI systems with external tools and data sources. Invoke to implement tool handlers, configure resource providers, set up stdio/HTTP/SSE transport layers, validate schemas with Zod or Pydantic, debug protocol compliance issues, or scaffold complete MCP server/client projects using TypeScript or Python SDKs.

copy.tagline: 构建、调试和扩展MCP服务器与客户端
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发或调试连接AI与外部工具的MCP服务。
copy.tagline_en: Build, debug, and extend MCP servers and clients
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building or debugging MCP services that connect AI with external tools.

howto.what: 让 Claude 能按 MCP 协议帮你搭建、调试和扩展连接 AI 与外部工具的服务器/客户端代码,包括定义接口、校验数据、设置传输,并提供 TypeScript/Python 示例。
howto.when: 当你要求构建、调试或扩展 MCP 服务器/客户端,或提到 “MCP”、“Model Context Protocol” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 TypeScript 搭建一个 MCP 服务器,并注册一个带校验的工具。
say.note: Claude 会按 MCP 规范生成代码和配置。

say.text: 调试这个 MCP 服务器的 JSON-RPC 返回,检查是否合规。
say.note: 它会指出协议错误并给出修复建议。

say.text: 用 Python 给 MCP 服务器增加一个资源提供者。
say.note: 它会生成对应的资源处理代码。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can build, debug, and extend MCP servers/clients that connect AI systems to external tools. It implements tool handlers, resource providers, transport, and schema validation, and gives TypeScript/Python examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build, debug, or extend MCP servers/clients, or mention keywords like “MCP” or “Model Context Protocol”.

say_en.text: Help me scaffold a TypeScript MCP server with a validated tool.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code and config per MCP spec.

say_en.text: Debug this MCP server's JSON-RPC responses for compliance.
say_en.note: It will point out protocol errors and fixes.

say_en.text: Add a resource provider to my MCP server in Python.
say_en.note: It will produce the resource handler code.
